relations.statement: G3 holds: every constituent MU triple of a pairwise MU seven-basis family has a fourth MU basis in the family, and absence of fourth bases for all MU triples excludes a four-basis MU family.
relations.hypotheses: Opaque Basis and MU predicates; no interpretation in complex matrices assumed.

lemmas.statement: Target restated: g3_theorem proves G3 for opaque Basis and MU.
If no MU triple has a fourth MU basis, then there is no four-basis MU family (NoFourMUB6).

near_misses.claim: Combinatorial G3 transfers directly to C^6 mutually unbiased bases without an interpretation of Basis and MU as complex-matrix notions.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Opaque predicates carry no unitary or overlap structure; the bottleneck requires a concrete interpretation.
